summary: Woodward, Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 solely to disclose that its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share, payable on September 3, 2026, to holders of record as of August 20, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. The filing is a routine declaration of a regular dividend, which does not represent a corporate transformation or special situation. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics to analyze; the event is simply a standard dividend announcement.
